dataset_full: Female Adult Fly Brain, proofread snapshot 783
mapping: Authored: world sensors inject current into labeled FlyWire populations (ORNs/PNs, LC/LPLC loom VPNs, photoreceptors, bristle/JO, GRNs). Hunger/thirst only scale feeding-related channels. Motor verbs are decoded from descending / brain-motor population rates. The graph and weights are FlyWire's.
limits: FAFB is brain-only (no VNC). Leg/wing motor neurons are absent; locomotion is read from descending neurons. Glutamate is treated as inhibitory (GluCl). LIF parameters are a real-time approximation, not a biophysical fit.
